svg.aria-label: How MikroORM's packages build on each other
svg.title: How MikroORM's packages build on each other
svg.desc: @mikro-orm/core sits in the middle. The inner ring is built on core: @mikro-orm/sql and @mikro-orm/mongodb. The outer ring is built on @mikro-orm/sql: the PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, libSQL and SQL Server drivers.
